takeaways: Lument is reportedly headed back to the Hunt family in a deal that could top $1B and moves a ~$57B servicing book, the latest sign of agency-lending consolidation. (via The Promote)
The 10-year Treasury is lingering near 24-year highs (~5.2%), repricing CRE debt and squeezing refinancings before any Fed move.
Senior housing fundamentals keep improving: Brookdale occupancy hit 83.1% (+130 bps YoY) while BDT & MSD pursue a ~$1B Sunrise buyout.

items.headline: Lument may return to the Hunt family in deal tied to ~$57B servicing book
items.summary: Sources say Orix is nearing a sale of agency lender Lument to Hunt Cos. (CEO Chris Hunt); BofA's process was expected to draw $1B+ bids for the ~$57B servicing portfolio and 30+ offices. Another real estate dynasty re-entering agency lending, alongside Springmont/Bayview's BWE deal and Fifth Third's $130M Fannie license purchase, signals continued consolidation in multifamily/HUD lending. (via The Promote)

items.headline: 10-year Treasury hovers near 24-year highs, pressuring CRE refinancing
items.summary: The 10-year yield backed off its 24-year high after a solid bond auction but still sits near 5.2%, with Pimco warning of 6%. Rising benchmark rates reprice CRE debt ahead of any Fed move and strain maturing-loan refinancing, a key watch item for senior housing borrowers.

items.headline: Brookdale occupancy reaches 83.1%, up 130 bps year over year
items.summary: Brookdale reported Q3 2026 weighted-average occupancy of 83.1% across 529 communities in 41 states (~45,000 residents), up 70 bps sequentially and outpacing NIC stabilized market occupancy. Continued demand recovery supports operator pricing and NOI trends for peers.

items.headline: BDT & MSD to buy Sunrise Senior Living in ~$1B deal
items.summary: BDT & MSD Partners agreed to acquire luxury operator Sunrise Senior Living in a roughly $1B transaction, reinforcing large-scale private capital appetite for senior housing operating platforms. (via The Promote)

items.headline: Reuben Brothers take 888 Brickell note; Newmark courts equity for D&G supertall
items.summary: The Reubens now hold the $35.7M senior note on Michael Stern's 888 Brickell site, valued just over $100M, as Newmark markets for an equity partner needed to close $600M+ of construction financing. 259 condos planned at ~$2,100/sf. (via The Promote)

items.headline: Terra lands $507M Miami Beach construction loan before pre-sales
items.summary: David Martin's Terra Group secured a $507M construction loan from Tyko Capital for the 106-unit 1250 West Ave condo, unusual for South Florida because financing arrived before pre-sales. (via The Promote)

items.headline: DST equity fundraising jumps 27% year over year
items.summary: Delaware statutory trust equity raising rose 27% YoY, a sign of retail/1031 capital flowing back into CRE even as rates stay elevated. (via The Promote)

items.headline: Citi flags concern on Bank OZK's $915M San Diego IQHQ loan
items.summary: Bank OZK shares dropped after Citi flagged mortgage concerns on a $915M loan to IQHQ in San Diego, another lab/office credit worry for construction lenders. (via The Promote)

items.headline: Senior living dealbook: LTC closes $160M acquisition; NHI invests $107.7M in SHOP
items.summary: LTC Properties completed a $160M acquisition and NHI committed $107.7M to senior housing operating portfolio expansion, showing healthcare REITs leaning further into SHOP structures.

items.headline: Q3 proptech funding hits $2.21B, led by EliseAI's $350M Series F
items.summary: Proptech venture funding totaled ~$2.21B in Q3, with the top seven deals making up ~58%. Investors favored AI embedded in workflows (leasing automation, construction scheduling) over standalone tools; construction tech was a recurring theme.

items.headline: Data-center tenant stress: Oracle reportedly balks at rent owed to Blue Owl
items.summary: Force majeure language surfaced in the AI data-center buildout as Oracle reportedly told Blue Owl it may not pay rent as expected, raising questions about the AI capex equation for landlords. (via The Promote)

items.headline: General Dynamics and Stryker name internal successors as CEOs
items.summary: General Dynamics (Danny Deep) and Stryker (Spencer Stiles) will hand CEO roles to 25- and 27-year veterans effective Jan. 1, 2027, with predecessors moving to executive chair, a continuity-first succession model.

items.headline: Jensen Huang: be prepared to suffer to succeed
items.summary: Nvidia's CEO told audiences that suffering and fear of failure are part of success, a counterpoint to flat-structure retention tactics Nvidia is also known for.

items.headline: Oura pulls IPO hours before pricing despite ~5x oversubscription
items.summary: Oura sought $40-$44 per share (up to a $15.6B valuation), but 73% of shares came from existing holders. Analysts cite valuation, insider cash-out and Apple competition. Overlaps with the aging-in-place wearables trend.

items.headline: Small changes in sleep, diet and exercise may add years to life
items.summary: New research suggests tiny daily improvements in sleep, nutrition and activity can meaningfully extend lifespan, supporting resident wellness programming over dramatic overhauls.
